$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the money-path file list (#1030).
This list previously existed in three places that disagreed: the Merge Gate in
(which auto-applies the money-path label and was MISSING the delegation rail,
the rail seam, and the SDK signer), and prose in docs/. A money-path list that
is wrong in one copy is worse than no list: the label is what selects money.md
and its characterization-test bar, so a missing glob silently lowers the bar.
- scripts/ci/qa-freshness.mjs  — decides whether a promotion needs a fresh
- scripts/ci/money-path.test.mjs — asserts this file, labeler.yml, and the
SKILL.md Merge Gate all agree. Editing one without the others fails CI.
Adding a glob here is cheap and safe. Leaving one out is the failure mode.
Globs are repo-root-relative and match the SKILL.md Merge Gate exactly.
